lines.t: In the silence of your longing heart
You searched the world and fell apart
But I have watched, I have known your cries
Beloved, lift your eyes to the sky
Only one who can fulfill your hearts in the most desire
I am he, beloved, eternal fire
No other love can ever satisfy
I am He, Beloved
Yahushua, Most High
Come out from among them
Turn away
Let the shadows fade
in today be joined unto me your soul restored for i am the promise forever
only one who can fulfill your heart sin of most desire i am here beloved
Beloved, eternal fire. No other love can ever satisfy. I am here, beloved. Yahushua, most high.
Let peace like rivers flow within
For my mercy covers every sin
Beloved child, you're precious to me
I am He who sets you free
Only one who can fulfill your heart's innermost desire
I am He, beloved, eternal fire Find your rest and come every night
For I am He, your dwelling most high
Thank you.
